question: What is the universal vibration described in this teaching?
premises: There are first and last moments in the grasping of things.
In those moments a state appears that is full of surging bliss.
That bliss is identified with the bliss of the whole world.
inference: This state is called the universal vibration.
plain_english: In the first and last moments of grasping things, that state which is fully filled with surging bliss and made of the bliss of the whole world is called the universal vibration.
